rule: I am · He / She / It is · You / We / They are
expbn: কেউ কী, কে বা কেমন আছে বলতে am / is / are লাগে। বাংলায় অনেক সময় এই ক্রিয়াটা লুকানো থাকে (“আমি ছাত্র”), কিন্তু ইংরেজিতে বাদ দেওয়া যায় না।
I এর সাথে am, he / she / it বা একজনের সাথে is, আর you / we / they বা অনেকের সাথে are।
rulebn: I am · He / She / It is · You / We / They are
sub: Saying what someone or something is
exp: Use am, is or are to say who someone is, what something is, or how someone is. In Bangla this verb is often left out, but in English you always need it: I am a student.
Use am with I. Use is with he, she, it or one person or thing. Use are with you, we, they or more than one.

rule: a + consonant sound (a book) · an + vowel sound (an apple) · the = the one we both know

ex.en: She eats an apple every day.

q.s: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.

expbn: একটা যেকোনো জিনিস বোঝাতে a বা an। শব্দের শুরুর উচ্চারণ স্বরধ্বনি (a, e, i, o, u-এর শব্দ) হলে an, না হলে a।
নির্দিষ্ট, আগে বলা বা দুজনেই চেনে এমন জিনিস বোঝাতে the।
rulebn: a + ব্যঞ্জনধ্বনি (a book) · an + স্বরধ্বনি (an apple) · the = নির্দিষ্টটা
sub: Which one: a, an or the
exp: Use a or an for one thing when it doesn't matter which one. Use an before a vowel sound (an apple, an hour) and a before other sounds (a book, a university).
Use the when you and the listener know which one you mean: something you have already mentioned, or the only one there is.

rule: I / You / We / They work · He / She / It works · doesn't work

ex.en: The sun rises in the east.
We go to the gym on Sundays.

bnsub: Simple present: অভ্যাস আর সাধারণ সত্য
expbn: যা নিয়মিত হয় বা সবসময় সত্য, তা বলতে simple present। যেমন রোজকার রুটিন।
he / she / it হলে ক্রিয়ার শেষে s বা es যোগ হয়। না-বোধক করতে don't / doesn't।
rulebn: I / You / We / They work · He / She / It works · doesn't work
sub: Habits and things that are always true
exp: Use the simple present for routines and habits (I drink tea every morning) and for facts that are always true (water boils at 100 degrees).
With he, she or it, add -s or -es to the verb: she works, he watches. For negatives use don't or doesn't + the base verb.

ex.en: I am reading a book now.

q.s: We ___ for the bus right now.
I ___ to music at the moment.
He ___ TV now. He is studying.

expbn: এই মুহূর্তে চলছে এমন কাজ বলতে am / is / are + ক্রিয়ার সাথে ing।
Look!, now, right now, at the moment এই শব্দগুলো দেখলে সাধারণত এটাই বসে।
exp: Use am, is or are + the verb with -ing for something happening at this moment: I am reading.
Words like now, right now, at the moment and Look! often go with this tense.

ex.en: She went to Sylhet last week.

q.s: We ___ go out because of the rain.

expbn: অতীতে শেষ হয়ে যাওয়া কাজ বলতে simple past। সাধারণ ক্রিয়ায় শেষে ed (work → worked)।
অনেক ক্রিয়ার রূপ আলাদা, এগুলো মুখস্থ করতে হয়: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate। না-বোধক করতে didn't + মূল ক্রিয়া।
exp: Use the simple past for actions that started and finished in the past. Regular verbs add -ed: work → worked.
Many common verbs are irregular and you need to learn them: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate. For negatives use didn't + the base verb: He didn't call.

rule: Do you…? · Does she…? · Did they…? + base verb

q.s: ___ you see the match last night?

bnsub: প্রশ্ন বানানো: do, does, did দিয়ে
expbn: সাধারণ ক্রিয়ার বাক্যকে প্রশ্ন বানাতে শুরুতে Do / Does / Did বসে, আর মূল ক্রিয়া আগের রূপে ফিরে যায় (s বা ed থাকে না)।
he / she / it হলে Does, অতীত হলে সবার জন্য Did।
rulebn: Do you…? · Does she…? · Did they…? + মূল ক্রিয়া
sub: Making questions with do, does and did
exp: To make a question with an ordinary verb, put Do, Does or Did at the start. The main verb goes back to its base form (no -s, no -ed).
Use Does with he, she or it. Use Did for the past with everyone: Did you see it?

rule: will + verb · am / is / are going to + verb

ex.en: We are going to buy a new car.
ex.bn: আমরা একটা নতুন গাড়ি কিনতে যাচ্ছি।

ex.en: She is going to study abroad.

q.s: The phone is ringing. I ___ answer it.
We ___ visit Cox's Bazar next month. We booked the hotel.
I think it ___ be a good day.
She ___ to start a new job.

expbn: এখনই নেওয়া সিদ্ধান্ত, প্রতিশ্রুতি বা অনুমান বোঝাতে will।
আগে থেকে ঠিক করা পরিকল্পনা বোঝাতে am / is / are going to।
rulebn: will + verb · am / is / are going to + verb
exp: Use will for decisions you make now, promises and predictions: I will call you later.
Use am, is or are going to for plans you have already made: We are going to buy a car.

rule: can / could / should / must + base verb

ex.bn: আপনি কি আমাকে সাহায্য করতে পারবেন?

ex.en: You must wear a seat belt.
ex.bn: তোমাকে অবশ্যই সিট বেল্ট পরতে হবে।

q.s: I ___ ride a bike when I was five.

bnsub: can, could, should, must: পারা, উচিত, বাধ্যতা
expbn: can = পারা (এখন), could = পারত (অতীত) বা ভদ্র অনুরোধ, should = উচিত (পরামর্শ), must = অবশ্যই করতে হবে।
এদের পরে সবসময় ক্রিয়ার মূল রূপ বসে, কোনো to বা s লাগে না।
rulebn: can / could / should / must + মূল ক্রিয়া
exp: can = able to (now), could = was able to (past) or a polite request, should = advice, must = it is necessary or a rule.
After these words, always use the base verb, with no to and no -s: She can swim. You should rest.

rule: at 5 pm · on Friday · in July │ in the bag · on the wall · at the door

ex.en: The keys are on the table.
I'll meet you at the station.
ex.bn: আমি স্টেশনে তোমার সাথে দেখা করব।

q.s: She is waiting ___ the bus stop.

bnsub: in, on, at: সময় আর জায়গা
expbn: সময়ে: at + নির্দিষ্ট সময় (at 5 o'clock), on + দিন বা তারিখ (on Monday), in + মাস, বছর, ঋতু (in May, in 2026)।
জায়গায়: in = ভিতরে (in the room), on = উপরে (on the table), at = নির্দিষ্ট জায়গায় (at the bus stop)।
rulebn: at 5 pm · on Friday · in July │ in the bag · on the wall · at the door
exp: Time: at for exact times (at 5 o'clock), on for days and dates (on Monday), in for months, years and seasons (in May, in 2026).
Place: in = inside (in the room), on = on a surface (on the table), at = at a point or place (at the bus stop).

rule: There is + one · There are + more than one · Is there…? / Are there…?

ex.en: There is a park near my house.
ex.bn: আমার বাসার কাছে একটা পার্ক আছে।

ex.en: There are five people in my family.

q.s: There ___ any milk in the fridge.

bnsub: There is / There are: কোথাও কিছু আছে বলতে
expbn: কোনো জায়গায় কিছু আছে বলতে there is (একটা) আর there are (অনেক)। প্রশ্নে Is there / Are there।
বাংলায় যেমন বলি “টেবিলে একটা বই আছে”, ইংরেজিতে বলি There is a book on the table।
rulebn: There is + একটা · There are + অনেক · Is there…? / Are there…?
exp: Use there is for one thing and there are for more than one. In questions: Is there…? / Are there…?
Many languages start with the place (“On the table, a book is”). In English, start with there: There is a book on the table.

rule: tall → taller → the tallest · expensive → more expensive → the most expensive

ex.en: My brother is taller than me.
This phone is more expensive than that one.
Dhaka is the biggest city in Bangladesh.
She is the best student in the class.

q.s: A car is ___ than a bike.
This is the ___ day of my life.
English is ___ than math for me.
He is the ___ player in the team.
This hotel is ___ than the other one.

expbn: দুটো জিনিসের তুলনায় ছোট বিশেষণের শেষে er + than (bigger than)। লম্বা বিশেষণের আগে more (more beautiful than)।
সবার মধ্যে সেরা বোঝাতে the + est (the biggest) বা the most (the most beautiful)। ব্যতিক্রম: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst।
rulebn: tall → taller → the tallest · expensive → more expensive → the most expensive
exp: To compare two things, add -er + than to short adjectives (bigger than). Put more before long adjectives (more beautiful than).
For the top one in a group, use the + -est or the most (the biggest, the most beautiful). Irregular: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst.

rule: many books · much water │ I have some · Do you have any? · I don't have any

ex.en: How much money do you need?

q.s: There aren't ___ chairs in the room.

bnsub: much, many, some, any: পরিমাণ বোঝাতে
expbn: যা গোনা যায় (books, people) তার সাথে many, যা গোনা যায় না (water, money, time) তার সাথে much।
হ্যাঁ-বোধক বাক্যে some, প্রশ্ন আর না-বোধক বাক্যে সাধারণত any।
rulebn: many books · much water │ I have some · Do you have any? · I don't have any
exp: Use many with things you can count (books, people) and much with things you can't count (water, money, time).
Use some in positive sentences and any in questions and negatives: I bought some eggs. Do you have any questions?

rule: have / has + past participle (gone, seen, finished)

ex.en: She has never been to India.

q.s: They have worked here ___ five years.

bnsub: Present perfect: অভিজ্ঞতা আর এখন পর্যন্ত
expbn: have / has + ক্রিয়ার তৃতীয় রূপ (done, seen, eaten)। অতীতে হয়েছে কিন্তু তার প্রভাব বা গুরুত্ব এখনো আছে, অথবা জীবনের অভিজ্ঞতা বোঝাতে।
নির্দিষ্ট অতীত সময় (yesterday, last year) থাকলে present perfect না, simple past বসে। already, yet, ever, never, since, for এর সাথে প্রায়ই এটা আসে।
rulebn: have / has + past participle (gone, seen, finished)
sub: Experiences and results up to now
exp: Use have or has + the past participle (done, seen, eaten) for life experiences and past actions that matter now: I have finished my work.
Don't use it with a finished time like yesterday or last year; use the simple past instead. It often goes with already, yet, ever, never, just, since and for.

ex.en: If it rains, we will stay home.
If you study hard, you will pass.
ex.bn: কষ্ট করে পড়লে তুমি পাস করবে।

ex.en: I will call you if I need help.
ex.bn: সাহায্য লাগলে আমি তোমাকে ফোন করব।

ex.en: If she comes, I will tell her.
If we leave now, we won't be late.
ex.bn: এখন বের হলে আমাদের দেরি হবে না।

q.s: If you ___ early, you will catch the bus.
If it is sunny, we ___ to the beach.
I will be happy if you ___.
If he ___ hurry, he will miss the train.
What ___ you do if you lose your job?

bnsub: If দিয়ে শর্ত: যদি এটা হয়, তাহলে ওটা হবে
expbn: ভবিষ্যতে সম্ভব কোনো শর্ত বোঝাতে If + present, তারপর will + মূল ক্রিয়া।
If-এর অংশে will বসে না। যেমন If it rains (ঠিক), If it will rain (ভুল)।
sub: If this happens, that will happen
exp: Use If + present tense, then will + verb for a possible situation in the future: If it rains, we will stay home.
Don't use will in the if part. Say If it rains, not If it will rain.

rule: is / are / was / were + past participle (made, built, written)

ex.en: This shirt is made in Bangladesh.
English is spoken in many countries.
The results will be announced tomorrow.

q.s: Rice ___ in many parts of Asia.
The window ___ by the children yesterday.

bnsub: Passive voice: কাজটা কে করেছে তার চেয়ে কাজটাই জরুরি
expbn: কাজটা কে করেছে জানা নেই বা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ না হলে passive ব্যবহার হয়: be + ক্রিয়ার তৃতীয় রূপ।
কে করেছে বলতে চাইলে শেষে by যোগ করা যায়: The book was written by Humayun Ahmed।
rulebn: is / are / was / were + past participle (made, built, written)
sub: When the action matters more than who did it
exp: Use the passive when we don't know or don't care who did the action: be + the past participle (made, built, written).
To say who did it, add by at the end: The book was written by Humayun Ahmed.
